messages:
Anya: heads-up — intake for a lightweight bring-up of `open-retro-3b` requested by product. goal: quick triage + a mini-harness run to decide if we escalate to full onboard.
Mike: cool, what are the non-negotiables for this quick pass?
Anya: keep it minimal — perf baseline (latency/throughput), quantization risk check, and quality smoke on ~5 priority prompt suites. no full eval yet.
Raj: assigned to me. i'll do a rapid perf profile on a single A100 first. plan: 1) baseline float32, 2) int8 dynamic (fx), 3) q4_k_m via GPTQ. should we also run KV cache warmup traces?
Anya: yes KV warmup traces please — we saw weird startup latency on last bring-up. add a short session with long ctx.
Sophie: for quality smoke, which prompt sets? suggest: 1) convo flow (20 prompts), 2) code editing (10), 3) multilang short (15), 4) summarization (10), 5) toxic safety quick check (10).
Raj: got it. i'll script a mini-harness that hits each set once and captures: pplx (where applicable), EM/ROUGE-ish where relevant, hallucination flag (binary), and latency P50/P95.
Anya: pass/fail heuristics proposal: no >3% regression on pplx vs our 3b baseline, latency P95 within 1.5x baseline, and zero critical safety regressions on toxic checks. if one condition fails — escalate to full eval.
Mike: ops checklist for dedicated run: env: CUDA 11.8, magma kernels, batch sizes [1,4,8], seq len [128,1024], and enable continuous batching flag. I'll set up a temporary dedicated pool with 2 nodes.
Raj: mini harness command i'm going to use (local):
```
./mini_eval.sh --model=open-retro-3b --quant=q4_k_m --prompts=priority_sets.json --out=mini_run.json --profile=true
```
Sophie: i'll prepare `priority_sets.json` and include short expected-output annotations so the harness can auto-detect hallucinations (heuristic). leaving some TBCs for edge cases.
Anya: timeline: start now, 3-4h to gather runs + perf traces, then a 30m sync. Can EvalBot run the automated smoke runner after Raj finishes? :slightly_smiling_face:
EvalBot: scheduled job queued — will run validation pipeline when `mini_run.json` appears in /evals/mini/. auto-report to this thread.
Raj: first float32 baseline done. quick numbers: pplx ~ 18.4 (baseline 17.9), P95 latency 420ms (baseline 310ms) on A100. KV warmup reduced P95 by ~15% after 3 requests. saving artifacts to s3://redwood-temp/open-retro/mini/1718203345/
Sophie: initial quality smoke results (summary): convo pass 18/20, code-editing 9/10, summarization 8/10 (two brevity issues), multilang 13/15 (minor tokenization), toxic safety flagged 1/10 (edge-case profanity misclass).
Anya: quick triage: pplx delta 2.8% — within threshold. latency P95 1.35x baseline — within 1.5x. toxic flag is concerning but single edge-case. Recommend: proceed to quantized run and gated canary, not full onboard yet.
Mike: starting q4_k_m run now. note: for quantized run we should test sequence len 2048 for prod-safety. I'll spin a node with 80GB vram.
Raj: q4_k_m results: pplx 19.0 (delta 6.1%), P95 370ms (improved), safety flags 2/10 (the previous + one more). that's above our quick-pass pplx threshold.
Sophie: looking at examples — one high-impact regression in summarization: factual omission on a legal clause. tagging examples in the report.
Anya: decision point: quantized run fails quick pplx threshold. options: 1) try different quant (int8 dyn) 2) try calibration or outlier-aware GPTQ tweaks 3) block until full eval. My vote: try int8 dyn and a small calibration pass, low-cost.
Raj: agree. will try int8 and a GPTQ tweak (clamp outliers). ETA 2h.
EvalBot: mini report uploaded: s3://redwood-temp/open-retro/mini/1718203345/report.json — summary + per-prompt diffs.
Mike: noted ops lessons: enable kernel autotune and set environment var REDWOOD_BATCHER_MAX_DELAY=10ms for canary.
Sophie: i've updated the prompt suite with the failing summarization cases and added expected reasoning assertions. put in PR: https://git.internal/redwood/evals/pulls/142
Anya: thanks team. next sync in 2.5h unless Raj posts new artifacts earlier. if int8 still fails we'll open a full onboard ticket and attach these artifacts. :+1:
Raj: will post results here. moving to int8 now.
Sophie: small note — product asked for latency target <=350ms P95 for interactive tier. keep that in mind for gating.
Anya: noted. adding to the ticket template: product_target_latency_p95=350ms.
Raj: int8 run finished: pplx 18.6 (delta 3.9%), P95 355ms, safety flags back to 1/10. much better but pplx still slightly above 3%.
Anya: conclusion: borderline. recommend a canary deploy with target routing 10% and close monitoring (per-prompt quality alarms + immediate rollback if summarization EM drops by >5%). create canary ticket and include `mini_run.json` and `report.json`.
Mike: will prepare canary infra and a rollback playbook.
EvalBot: creating canary dashboard with thresholds: pplx_delta_threshold=3%, summarization_em_drop=5%, safety_flags_threshold=2. dashboard: https://metrics.redwood/internal/d/mini-canary/1718203345
Anya: great. i'll file the canary ticket and assign owners. thanks everyone.
